data_issues.issue: Dataset address is 4701 Charlotte Pike; the market's own site (richlandparkfarmersmarket.com, checked 2026-10-21) says 4711 Charlotte Avenue. Rechecked 2026-10-23: site still says 4711 Charlotte Avenue.

Downtown Services (downtownservices.org/?p=93538, checked 2026-10-23) says 'This year marked Pearl Market's final season after 26 years'. The market looks closed; Common Greens now runs the Thursday Downtown Columbus Farmers Market at Columbus Commons instead.
Could not find any 2026 listing or official site for Merion Village Farmers' Market (106 E. Moler St.); it is not on the Franklin County Auditor's 2026 list. May be closed.
Dataset has no schedule or website. Franklin County Auditor 2026 list: Saturdays May 2-Nov 21, 9am-1pm, 555 S Third St, facebook.com/germanvillagefarmersmarket. Some listings give 588 S Third St.

Missing Columbus markets on the Franklin County Auditor 2026 list: Clintonville Farmers Market (3535 N High St, the city's biggest Saturday market), Downtown Columbus Farmers Market (Columbus Commons), Bronzeville Growers Market (925 Mt Vernon Ave), Conservatory Farmers Market (1777 E Broad St), Westgate Farmers Market (2925 W Broad St). The page lists only 3 markets, one closed.
data_issues.resolution: Added Clintonville, Downtown Columbus, Conservatory, Bronzeville and Westgate to data/enrichment/added-markets.json (2026-10-23). OhioHealth Market left out: its page says it is for OhioHealth staff only.

data_issues.issue: Dataset lists a winter Lyndale market, but the market's own site (mplsfarmersmarket.com/about, checked 2026-10-26) gives only a 2026 season of May 2-October 31.

Dataset puts the Kingfield winter market at 4901 Chowen Ave S. Neighborhood Roots (neighborhoodrootsmn.org/winter-markets, checked 2026-10-26) runs its 2026-27 winter markets at Bachman's, 6010 Lyndale Ave S.

Mill City appears twice (mill-city-farmers-market-minneapolis at 704 S 2nd St and mill-city-farmers-market-minneapolis-1 at 750 S 2nd St). The official site gives 750 S 2nd St as the market address and 704 S 2nd St as the mailing address.

Dataset puts the Northeast winter market at 629 NE 2nd St (the summer lot). The market's site (northeastmarket.org/visit, checked 2026-10-26) says winter markets are at East Side Neighborhood Services, 1700 2nd St NE.

Dataset puts Urban Harvest at 3000 Richmond Ave. The official market page (urbanharvest.org/urban-harvest-farmers-market, checked 2026-11-01) gives 2752 Buffalo Speedway, Saturdays 8am-12pm year-round. Its FAQ page still shows an older address, 1911 W. 34th St.
Bayou City Farmers Market shares the old Urban Harvest address (3000 Richmond Ave) and has no website or schedule. Likely a stale duplicate or closed market; not confirmed.
braeswoodfarmersmarket.com (checked 2026-11-01) now lists rotating pop-up markets at Memorial Hermann hospitals and La Centerra in Katy, not a fixed market at 5401 S Braeswood.
Dataset lists Monday and Wednesday. hopefarmshtx.org/market-days (checked 2026-11-01) says the market is every 1st Saturday, 9am-2pm, at 10401 Scott St.
The listed website whiteoakfarmersmarket.com does not resolve (DNS lookup fails, 2026-11-01). The market may have closed.
The Westchase District site no longer has a farmers market page (old page 404s and the events page does not list it, 2026-11-01). Thursday schedule is unconfirmed.

The city lists 64 markets but many are duplicates of the same market from different sources: Hollywood (hollywood-farmers-market-los-angeles, hollywood-fm-los-angeles-3ab61fcb), Old LA (old-la-certified-farmers-market-los-angeles and -1), Lincoln Heights (3 entries), Atwater Village, Echo Park, Mar Vista, Miracle Mile, Melrose Place, Larchmont, Adams/Vermont, Central Ave, Crenshaw/Harambee (5730 Crenshaw Blvd), Westwood Village, East Hollywood, LA Cienega, Fig at 7th, Bank of America/Bunker Hill (333 S Hope St). Inflates the count shown on the page.
Brea Certified Farmers' Market is in Brea (Orange County), per its website breachamber.com; the dataset files it under Los Angeles with a downtown LA mailing address (1308 Factory Place).
Listed website wellingtonsquarefarmersmarket.com now serves casino spam (checked 2026-11-03). The link should be removed.
Dataset address is 7000 W Manchester Ave; the market's site (westchesterfarmersmkt.com, checked 2026-11-03) says Sundays 9am-1pm at 6200 W 87th St, in Westchester's Downtown Triangle.
Dataset says 5th St and Spring St; SFMA (sfma.net/dtla, checked 2026-11-03) gives 209 W 5th St, from Broadway to Main St, Sundays 10am-3pm.
